description: Provenance for the SEFAZ NF-e XSD packs vendored in this directory, alongside this manifest. Scoped to one MOC version: each generated/moc<version>/schemas/ carries its own MANIFEST.json, so a future MOC 8.0 pack gets generated/moc8.0/schemas/MANIFEST.json rather than overwriting this one. The SEFAZ update-watch routine diffs this manifest against the portal to detect new Notas Técnicas / schema packs.

packs.name: PL_009i_NT2021_004_v100d
packs.description: Full layout 4.00 pack — web-service envelope schemas + NF-e leiaute.

packs.name: PL_010d_v1.03
packs.description: CNPJ Alfanumérico — supersedes PL_010c. Widens every CNPJ-typed field and the chave de acesso from numeric to alphanumeric per RFB Instrucao Normativa 2.229/2024: TCnpj and TCnpjVar become [0-9A-Z]{12}[0-9]{2}, TCnpjOpc [0-9]{0}|[0-9A-Z]{12}[0-9]{2}, TChNFe [0-9]{6}[0-9A-Z]{12}[0-9]{26} and infNFe/@Id NFe + the same. Note the alphanumeric window in a chave is exactly positions 6-17 (the CNPJ's 12-char body) — the CNPJ's two check digits and everything after stay numeric. Implantacao teste 01/06/2026, producao 01/07/2026. The pack also carries the NT 2026.001 PAA group (infPAA/PAASignature) and the xmldsig TRSAKeyValueType, which is why the generated type count moved 173 -> 177. Vendored from PL_010d_v1.03.zip, whose NFe/ copies are preferred over the NT2026.004 v1.01 wrapper's: they additionally fix the NFC-e QR-code facet to accept an alfa CNPJ ([0-9]{3,14} -> ([0-9A-Z]{12}[0-9]{2})|([0-9]{11})) and drop a stale TCnpjVar 'tamanho variavel (3-14)' doc string. Files normalised to LF to match the rest of this directory; the zip ships CRLF.

packs.name: PL_010c_NT2022_002v1.30
packs.description: NF-e leiaute delta — overlays the NF-e structure files over the base pack and adds DFeTiposBasicos.

packs.name: Evento_Generico_PL_v1.01
packs.description: Generic NF-e evento pack — the evento transport envelope (envEvento / retEnvEvento / procEventoNFe), the shared TEvento leiaute, and the v1.03 basic types used by the whole evento family. tiposBasico_v1.03.xsd is byte-identical in all four evento packs; it is attributed here, to the pack that owns the envelope. The pack's own xmldsig-core-schema copy is not vendored — the PL_009i one is. The portal entry names no Nota Técnica, hence nt: null.

packs.name: Evento_CCe_PL_v1.01
packs.description: Carta de Correção Eletrônica — supplies only the tpEvento 110110 detEvento payload schema. The pack's CCe-specific envelope files (envCCe, leiauteCCe, retEnvCCe, procCCeNFe, CCe) are deliberately not vendored: the envelope comes from Evento_Generico_PL_v1.01 and the payload is fed into its detEvento #raw slot. The portal entry names no Nota Técnica, hence nt: null.
